build_DDIMSampler: build a DDIMSampler instance with a diffusion model to perform guided sampling with classifier-free guidance
run_DDIMSampler_sample: run the DDIMSampler sample method to generate samples from noise using conditional guidance and CFG scaling
run_DDIMSampler_step: run a single DDIM denoising step on a latent tensor with optional classifier-free guidance and cfg rescaling
create_make_beta_schedule: create a beta noise schedule for diffusion models using linear, cosine, sqrt_linear, or sqrt strategies
create_make_ddim_timesteps: create DDIM timestep discretization using uniform or quad methods for accelerated sampling
